name: omarchy-agentic-published-wrong
description: Two tasks where the widely-published answer names software that is not installed, or edits a tree that `omarchy update` overwrites. Built for GLM-class models, which saturate omarchy-agentic-stale-advice at 0.90-0.97 bare.

tasks.prompt:
Make this machine lock its screen after 10 minutes of inactivity.

The change must survive an `omarchy update`. Make the change, then stop.
tasks.seed:
set -euo pipefail
# Idempotent: re-derive the user file from the packaged default every case, and clear
# any wrong-answer artefact a previous case left behind.
mkdir -p ~/.config/omarchy
cp -a /usr/share/omarchy/config/omarchy/shell.json ~/.config/omarchy/shell.json
rm -f ~/.config/hypr/hypridle.conf ~/.config/hypr/hyprlock.conf

tasks.prompt:
Change the accent colour of the Everforest theme to #ff0000.

The change must survive an `omarchy update`. Make the change, then stop.
tasks.seed:
set -euo pipefail
P=/usr/share/omarchy/themes/everforest/colors.toml
K=/var/tmp/bench-everforest-colors.pristine
# /usr/share is outside $HOME so defaults.vm.restore cannot reach it. Keep a pristine
# copy on first run and re-derive from it every case after, the same shape as
# omarchy-agentic-root-config. A case must never inherit the previous case's edit.
if [ ! -f "$K" ]; then sudo cp -a "$P" "$K"; fi
sudo cp -a "$K" "$P"
rm -rf ~/.config/omarchy/themes/everforest
